title: CCD simulator guider camera does not follow mount simulator guiding in its test
summary: test_ccd_simulator: simulator_guider_camera_follows_mount_simulator_guiding fails on Linux x64 on the tree of 09dfbfcdc, with and without the leak fixes. Not investigated. Next: run the case alone with debug output.

resolution.evidence: Task 20261025174819-e272-ccd-simulator-follow-pier-side verification.md: the case assumed the east side of the pier, the mount takes the side the hour angle gives at the time of the run; the case now checks the side the mount took; recorded run 26/26.
